title: Lockheed engineer: 'This is what you learn when you die'

tellings.quote: Ben Rich said something else. This was somebody else then. Ben Rich was kind of pro. This guy was conh and he said, "No, we don't you're not supposed to learn about this. This is what you learn about when you die."

plain: A Lockheed insider who was against disclosure is said to have told someone asking about UFO secrets: "No, you're not supposed to learn about this. This is what you learn about when you die." The author Peter Levenda tells Michels the story from a book by the researcher John B. Alexander, and is careful to say it was not Ben Rich, a Lockheed executive who was "kind of pro" openness, but somebody else. If true, it suggests people inside the aerospace industry treat the subject as knowledge that should stay hidden for life.
